entry_state: Assertions preserve source, measurement, time, perimeter and review meaning. Coverage, mapping and temporal selection are explicit procedures, and accepted transcription remains distinct from admissible accounting use. The next example tests these distinctions on a faithfully preserved but wrong source reference.
exit_state: The representation keeps literal source evidence, interpreted meaning, admitted information and committed accounting separate. Concrete reference, rounding, clock and treaty cases show why later corrections change selected conclusions without rewriting prior views or authorizing journals; the literature chapter now needs to justify the proposed methods.
findings: The wrong-reference example rejects156 as the actual auditor-report start while preserving its faithful transcription. Invalidation follows dependent selections, searches and coverage, without discarding unrelated financial amounts.

Nearest rounding is an explicit assumption; displayed precision alone imposes no half-unit interval. Date-only publication uses the actual local-midnight interval rather than a guessed noon or24-hour duration.

The treaty example separates late from unknown information, source from extraction correction, candidate-set changes from selected-ID stability, and revised measurement from authority to post. No new confirmed defect in the chapter.
